tagline: 福伦达旁轴相机，1974 年发布
description: 福伦达于1974年推出的旁轴相机。配备2.8/40 Color-Skopar, 4 elements in 3 groups.。快门速度1/500 s to 4 s in AE-mode, 1/30 s in flash mode.。使用rangefinder image, f-stop, shutter speed, bright frame, parallax marks, over/under-exposure.。感光度25 to 400 ASA。0.9 m to infinity。

specs.快门速度: 1/500 s to 4 s in AE-mode, 1/30 s in flash mode.
specs.胶片/画幅: rangefinder image, f-stop, shutter speed, bright frame, parallax marks, over/under-exposure.
specs.英文简介: A compact rangefinder camera for 35mm film; made by Rollei in Singapore, and sold under the Voigtländer brand.
